segments.name: North America
segments.note: Amazon's retail business in the US, Canada and Mexico — up 6% YoY; operating income of $8,723M, up 82% YoY.

segments.name: International
segments.note: Retail outside North America — up 5% YoY; operating income of $1,580M, up 32% YoY.

segments.name: AWS
segments.note: Amazon Web Services cloud computing — up 39% YoY, accelerating sharply; 23% of total sales but 63% of operating income ($17,773M, up 55% YoY, 38.7% margin).

opex.name: Fulfillment
opex.note: Warehouses, delivery and logistics — up 8% YoY.

opex.name: Technology & infrastructure
opex.note: Mostly AWS data centers and engineering — up 20% YoY as AI infrastructure spending surges.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Advertising and selling — essentially flat YoY.

opex.name: Other operating expense, net
opex.note: Miscellaneous operating items — down from $2,875M a year ago.

oneTimers: Q3 2025 non-operating income included $9.5B of pre-tax gains from Amazon's investments in Anthropic, which did not repeat — so net income fell 2% YoY despite operating income rising 61%. Total non-operating income was -$1,207M this quarter (interest income $1,187M, interest expense -$1,691M, other -$703M). The balance check also subtracts $4M of equity-method investment activity, net of tax.
verdict: Amazon's operating profit jumped 61% as AWS accelerated to 39% growth — but net income slipped, because last year's quarter included a $9.5B one-off Anthropic gain, and free cash flow went deeply negative on AI data-center spending.
otherDetail: Other expense of $1,207M (interest income $1,187M, interest expense -$1,691M, other -$703M), plus a $4M equity-method investment loss.
footerNote: Amazon reports cost of sales as cost of revenue; operating expenses are shown as the release lists them, including fulfillment and technology & infrastructure.
follow100Note: AWS takes $22.77 of every $100 in, but produces 63% of the operating profit — the retail business runs on far thinner margins.

takeaways.title: AWS is accelerating again
takeaways.text: AWS grew 39% to $46.0B — its fastest in years — and produced 63% of Amazon's entire operating profit at a 38.7% margin.

takeaways.title: Free cash flow went deeply negative
takeaways.text: Twelve-month free cash flow swung to -$42.4B from +$14.8B a year ago, as property and equipment purchases jumped $94.8B — the AI data-center buildout, paid in cash.

takeaways.title: Operating profit jumped — net income didn't
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 61% to $28.1B, but net income slipped 2%: last year's quarter included a $9.5B Anthropic investment gain that didn't repeat.
